preserve: Names, IDs, types, base stats, level32 evolution, learnsets, ordinary rarity and individual normal/shiny palettes remain unchanged.

families.theme: Superior-mirage inversion becomes a two-level trickster whose apparent face is visibly displaced above its small real body.

evolution_design.original_invention: The elevated pale false face is an optical echo drawn as fixed opaque pixel clusters, separated from the dark real body by white air. A stepped pale refraction streak relates both levels; no shader, transparency or new battle mechanic is needed.

body_growth.body: A low dark wisp with curled balancing fins and sly white real eyes projects a larger pale teardrop false face above itself. The gap between them is visible at native size.
body_growth.silhouette: Narrow stacked teardrop and small dark real body, with an offset refraction streak.

body_growth.body: The small true body becomes swift and broad, with swept curled lift fins. Its high false face grows into a broad inverted shield with three crown points, repeating horizontal refraction bands and bold misleading eye marks.
body_growth.silhouette: A broad elevated false shield over a very low dark flying body; the white gap and real lower eyes remain distinct.

supersedes_visual_text: Old solid upper lobe supported by a narrow bent neck.
families.reason: The newly requested redo makes the empty-air displacement itself visible instead of reading as an animal wearing a solid hat.

species.visual_theme: Two-level mirage trickster: pale floating teardrop false face above a small dark body with sly true white eyes.
A large elevated inverted false shield, repeated refractive horizon bands and a small swift true body with curled lift fins below.
